title: C.A.R.E Prompting
prompt:
Role:               Act as a [EXPERT ROLE  e.g. B2B sales coach].
Context:        I am [YOUR SITUATION  company, stage, industry].
Action:           [WHAT YOU WANT e.g. Give me 5 positioning ideas
                        to differentiate in the [MARKET / REGION]].
Expectation: Format as a numbered list. Each point 2–3 lines.
Use plain business language. No jargon.
CRAFTING EFFECTIVE AI PROMPTS
4 State Expectation
Clearly outline the desired format,
length, and tone of the output.
3 Start with Role
Begin the prompt by deﬁning the
AI's persona.
2 Fill C.A.R.E Layers
Provide context, action, role, and
expectation for the prompt.
Identify Need
1
Determine the speciﬁc task you
want the AI to perform.
PRO TIP
If your output feels off, the problem is almost always a vague Role or missing
Expectation. Fix those two before rewriting the whole prompt.
